workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.trackingIdHelp: Public six-character identifier of the site. It is not a secret and never changes.
workspace.switchFailed: The workspace could not be switched. Please try again.

help.production: Live environment: accepted events are delivered to your destinations and count towards your plan.
help.staging: Staging: events are flagged as test events, sent to test endpoints where the platform supports them and never billed.
help.development: Test environment for local checks: events are flagged as test events and never billed.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.description: Navigate, switch sites, open destinations or run an action.

assistant.title: Track AI
assistant.subtitle: Setup and diagnostics for your site
assistant.noSite: Track AI needs a site to work on.
assistant.composerHint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This page does not exist in your workspace or has moved.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: The error has been recorded. Try again or go back to the Command Center.

aiSetup.title: AI Setup
aiSetup.intro: Guided setup of your site: platform detection, snippet installation, consent, destinations, event plan, test and publish. Track AI chats with you in the side panel; this page is the step-by-step form with the same checks and drafts.
aiSetup.noSiteText: Create your first site to get a tracking ID and start the guided setup.

insights.title: Insights
insights.intro: Attribution and click-ID health: which click IDs are captured, how long they live, where they come from and whether they reach your destinations — separated into observed facts, modelled hints and unknowns.
insights.text: This module is being built. Nothing here is measured yet, so no numbers are shown. Until it ships, the Events module lists the accepted and dropped events of your site.

releases.title: Releases
releases.intro: Change & Release Center: drafts, test, staging and production, readable configuration diffs, approvals, scheduled publishing and one-click rollback.
releases.text: The release workflow is being built. Until it ships, publishing runs through the AI Setup review step, and the site page shows the version that is live.
releases.noSite: Create a site to publish a configuration.
